model.identity_note: Official Vision-Exp release (MIT, 2026-08-31): 32-block ViT + aligner, num_nextn_predict_layers=3, rms_norm_eps=1e-20, same DeepseekV4ForCausalLM architecture string as 0731.

runtime.transport: SparkRing patched NCCL 2.30.7 (switchless-cycle, skip-tree-pat, advertise-all-listener-gids) via LD_PRELOAD + VLLM_NCCL_SO_PATH

serving.sizing_note: KV pool 50-52 GiB per rank at util 0.80 = ~6.2M nvfp4_ds_mla tokens; weights 41.6 GiB per rank. Admission 48 keeps per-request decode >= 10 tok/s; 64 gives +11% aggregate at 8 tok/s per request.

evidence.site: one operator site, 2026-09-06, clusters re-cabled from two TP2 pairs
evidence.conditions: Fresh-prefix prompts, thinking off, temperature 0, 256 pinned decode tokens; prefill single request max_tokens=1; patched NCCL over two direct RoCE devices per rank; management-LAN bootstrap.
evidence.result: Decode aggregate tok/s C1 49, C4 112, C8 160-175, C16 235, C32 327, C48 391, C64 435 (steps/s 22 -> 200; acceptance 0.23-0.25). Prefill 2,300 / 2,255 / 2,100 tok/s at 16K / 64K / 128K; 560-660 tok/s past 180K (indexer-bound, same on TP2). 8x4K burst TTFT p50 7.8 s. NIAH 958,182 tokens exact in 963.9 s. 20-min C8 soak: 82 waves, 0 preemptions, 0 errors, 139 tok/s median. Same-stack TP2 pair: C1 31, C8 97, C16 141; prefill 1,600-1,800 / 1,600-1,685 / 1,410-1,550.
evidence.conclusion: Live-benchmarked on one site against the same stack at TP2; not reproduced elsewhere; no multi-hour soak; NIAH 1M at the 10% position only. Single failure domain.
